paper.title_en: Revisiting primordial black hole dark matter from axion inflation
paper.abstract_en: We revisit the production of primordial black holes (PBHs) by a U(1) gauge field with a pseudo-scalar coupling to the inflaton. We improve upon the existing literature by working in the homogeneous backreaction regime with numerically computed gauge mode functions, adopting state-of-the-art PBH abundance calculations, and incorporating the uncertainty in the statistics of $δρ$. We find that PBHs can account for all of the dark matter in the asteroidal mass range, even when the inflaton gradient energy density is highly subdominant ($10^{-4}$--$10^{-3}$ of the kinetic energy), supporting the validity of the backreaction scheme. This mechanism also unavoidably generates a stochastic gravitational wave background with an amplitude that will be measured at LISA and that will allow to indirectly discriminate between different statistics of $δρ$.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究轴子暴胀中规范场产生原初黑洞暗物质，并预言可被 LISA 测量的随机引力波背景，属于脉冲星计时阵列/引力波背景相关主题；理论机制具体，改进了以往文献并在均匀反作用区、数值模式函数与原初黑洞丰度计算上提升了方法严谨性，摘要清晰，值得点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 重新审视轴子暴胀产生的原初黑洞暗物质
decision.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了通过具有与暴胀子赝标量耦合的 U(1) 规范场产生原初黑洞（PBHs）的机制。相较于已有文献，我们作出了改进：在均匀反作用区中工作并采用数值计算的规范模式函数，采用最先进的原初黑洞丰度计算，并纳入 $\delta\rho$ 统计中的不确定性。我们发现，原初黑洞能够在小行星质量范围内解释全部暗物质，即使暴胀子梯度能量密度高度次主导（为动能的 $10^{-4}$--$10^{-3}$），这支持了反作用方案的有效性。该机制还不可避免地产生随机引力波背景，其振幅将在 LISA 被测量，并将允许间接区分 $\delta\rho$ 的不同统计。
